title: RStudio Connect Git Manifests
text: examples accesstocare package can deployed RStudio Connect using RStudio IDE’s button push deployment. examples designed deployed using RStudio Connect’s Git Backed Deployment. means tell RStudio Connect code repository exists, RStudio Connect download latest code everytime repository updated. major step accomplish , “manifest” file. contains metadata example, package versions, R version, primary file, etc. produced using rsconnect package. accesstocare, two utility functions make easier create manifest files.

title: RStudio Connect Git Manifests
text: two functions included accesstocare help creating manifests: atc_write_manifest() creates manifest single example atc_write_all_manifests() batch creates manifests

title: RStudio Connect Git Manifests
text: fs package make easy see changes directories. usage examples, copy accesstocare examples temporary folder.

title: Example content of Access to Care project
text: R package make easy view, copy, interact publish data products resulting Access Care analysis. also contains handy utility functions, data needed create consistent set examples across multiple data product types.

title: Example content of Access to Care project
text: project combines US Census population data hospital data provided Medicare. Census data 2024, hospital Medicare date 2025. analysis uses individual counties unit measurement. county considered undeserved based linear model.
